{{Quote|And just what do you think you're doing, snooping around my kitchens? Well? I'm waiting&hellip;|Kabray Station head cook to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 77">[[Star Wars (1977) 77|''Star Wars'' (1977) 77]]</ref>}}
This '''cook''' was the head chef at the luxurious [[Kabray Station]]. A heavy-set individual, he was very protective of his kitchen, and when [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agent, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] entered the cooking area of the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] searching for a message left by a fellow Rebel, [[Tay Vanis]], the cook immediately confronted her. Towering over the much smaller woman, the cook demanded to know why she was snooping around. Leia quickly bluffed that she was in the kitchen to get the particulars for her master, the [[Hoojib/Legends|Hoojib]], [[Plif/Legends|Plif]]. Leia insisted that Plif was incredibly picky about the food he ate, and so she needed to inspect the kitchens. The cook accepted her story and walked away, decrying the woman as a "finicky upstart".
